property_summary: After CEO calls DrugDealer() to set ceoAddress to itself, then a user buys drugs with 1 ether, the reference contract transfers 4% of msg.value (0.04 ether) to ceoAddress and the buggy contract transfers the full msg.value (1 ether) to ceoAddress, causing a different balance for the ceoAddress.
change_summary: Replace the transfer of devFee(msg.value) to the ceoAddress with a transfer of msg.value instead.
